semantic.justification: Task200 connects numeric ODFF source to real ScTokenArray/shared FormulaCompiler RPN, ScInterpreter and existing ScFormulaResult inside the actual document-sheet-column formula blocks. Native scalar arithmetic precedence, code/runtime error projection, lazy result state, default bracket completion, forced recalc and logical formula-block events are represented. ScSheetLimits, RTL parsing/cancellation, mdds and shared token/result owners are reused. Formula pointers use JS GC; no physical pointer deletion or reference counting is introduced. Source constructor/service subsets are explicit. References/functions, localized formatter/string conversion, groups/listening/recalc dependencies, serialization/ODS/UI, complete contexts/RNG/caches/vector/hash scheduling and broad parity remain unsupported. Native power fenv-only subnormal classifications reject explicitly. Formula block copy/clone is noncopyable and unavailable semantic equality throws instead of substituting identity. Broad parity/verification flags remain false. Task201 implements valid same-sheet ODFF A1 references through actual ScSingleRefData/ScSingleRefToken/RPN, borrowed document/formula cell views and numeric/empty/direct-text results. Actual shared Svt observers, typed broadcaster stores and native logical FormulaTrack/FormulaTree queues propagate edits and remove subscriptions on replacement/clear. Default dirty context is -1/-1/false; normal noniterative cycles return522; forced/manual modes and inserted-sheet positions are represented. Broad native constructor/service parity remains unverified. JS GC owns physical lifetime; Dispose closes semantic subscriptions/queues only. Cross-sheet/external/range/named references, functions, locale string-to-number conversion, area/group/iteration/deep-recursion services, full context/formatting, formula serialization, ODS and UI remain unsupported. These are bounded implementation slices, not broad native parity. Task202 serializes actual source-order scalar ODFF tokens through shared FormulaCompiler and ScCompiler reference convention into ScFormulaCell.GetFormula with explicit grammar. It preserves forced equals, source whitespace/quotes, native numeric presentation and relative/absolute A1 references at the actual cell position. It neither evaluates formulas nor stores an alternate text model. The shared native base reference hook remains empty; Calc overrides it. JS strings replace buffer fragments; actual OUString assignment preserves output ownership. Other grammars/localized symbol services,functions/names/external/range/matrix/table references and missing-argument rewrite services remain unsupported. Compiler string token output does not imply string-expression evaluation. Localized empty-code errors reject explicitly. ODS filters and UI are not implemented by this task; no broad native parity is certified. Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity. TaskGBSSRW implements native ScTokenArray deep Clone with independent code tokens and first matching cloned code identity reused by RPN;RPN-only tokens clone separately,retaining represented flags and leaving native finalized default false. Same-document same-position ScFormulaCell copy/Clone retains cached result,dirty state and grammar,deep-copies code and follows native nonempty-error reset/recompile rule without starting listeners. Unsupported relocation/foreign-document/name/external/group/reference-adjustment services remain explicit. Represented destructor tracking/listener cleanup uses existing Dispose. Native ScCellValue now owns empty/numeric/shared-string/formula values,copies real borrowed/document content and commits cloned formulas;current plain literal text setter maps source SetString/setTextInput semantics without format services. Browser Undo owns actual ScCellValue before/after and releases through existing SfxUndoAction Dispose;the browser stored-cell union and token snapshot reconstruction are removed. Full EditEngine/rich text,clone relocation,clipboard/undo document modes,format services and whole Calc parity remain unported. Block73 extends the prior bounded slices with native local/ODFF rectangular and whole-axis double references,shared RangeLine compilation,default scalar intersection,range aggregate execution over actual typed stores,and ordinary area-slot dependency ownership. Native logarithmic slot geometry,shared identity,bulk/deferred erasure,reference-update chaining,sheet shifts and semantic destruction are consumed without individual-cell listener expansion. ScValueIterator and RangeColumnSpanSet use actual document/column stores;portable array accumulation retains original four-stream Kahan order. Typed double out-references preserve encoded NaN payload storage. Earlier exclusions of these specific services are superseded here. Group/3D/external/named-reference expressions,matrix evaluation,nondefault subtotal/text-zero and number-format services remain unsupported;broader parity remains unverified. CALC250-252 record retained upstream edge behavior and limits on numerical evidence.
